opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted charities; must have at least one year’s worth of audited or examined annual accounts.
opportunities.summary: Provides operating/core cost, capital, or project grants up to £100,000 to eligible UK charities; applications accepted year‑round via online portal with no deadline.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted charities; must have annual income over £1 million or project/capital costs over £1 million; must have at least one year’s audited or examined accounts.
opportunities.summary: Provides major grants of £100,000 and above for operating/core costs, capital projects or specific projects to eligible UK charities; applications accepted year‑round via expression of interest with no deadline.
